brief: Indonesian lifestyle accessories for Gen Z - totes, caps, keychains, woven labels, tags, packaging. Batik meets Japanese aesthetics; a modern lifestyle brand first, a cultural one second.
criteria: Success: reads as a wrapped furoshiki at a glance, shows parang and seigaiha without intricate batik, works in pure black and white, survives 16 px and embroidery.

concepts.name: Furoshiki Bundle
concepts.idea: A furoshiki cloth tied into a bundle, printed with parang rusak and wrapping a row of seigaiha waves.
rationale: Furoshiki = the Japanese way of wrapping, the brand's product world
Parang band with its mlinjo bars = the Indonesian batik side, kept bold, not intricate
Seigaiha waves = the Japanese pattern side; one connected ink shape for print, embroidery and stamps
Small-size cut with one band and one wave row for favicon, avatar and woven label

recommendation: Furoshiki Bundle with the BHAPtik wordmark: black on cream as the primary, cream on black as the reverse, pink only on the knot and ears on dark grounds.
next_steps: Trademark search in Indonesia (DJKI) and target markets
Flatten the mask into plain shapes (Pathfinder) for embroidery and die-cut files
Embroidery and woven-label test at the smallest planned size
